title: Adjective + to ...
subtitle: hard to read, kind of you to, glad to, the first to, bound to

theory.text: hard to understand, easy to use

It's easy to use this app. = This app is easy to use. Во втором варианте объект в конце НЕ повторяется: не easy to use it. Так же с difficult, hard, nice, safe, cheap, expensive, interesting, impossible. Можно и с существительным: It's a hard word to spell.
It's kind / nice / silly / stupid / careless / generous / unfair of somebody to do — оценка поступка человека: It was kind of you to wait for me.

items: sorry / glad / pleased / surprised / relieved / disappointed / sad to ...: I was surprised to see him there.
the first / the second / the last / the only / the next to ...: She was the last to leave.
sure / bound / likely to ... — наверняка, вероятно: It's bound to rain. He's not likely to come.

theory.text: Русские часто добавляют лишнее местоимение: This book is easy to read it — ошибка. Правильно: This book is easy to read. А «было мило с твоей стороны» — nice of you, не nice from you.
